dial.summary: 4/8 indicators remain supportive on November 19 — Global M2 at $104.3T, ISM Manufacturing at 55.5, Fed Balance Sheet flat at $6.76T, and near-zero BTC funding (0.0040%) confirm a deleveraged market in classic accumulation conditions; DXY extended to 104.00 (fresh 19-month high on hawkish Fed undertone) is the dominant macro headwind; rising stablecoin dominance (13.2%) reflects elevated sidelined capital after the BTC pullback, consistent with accumulation conditions ahead of the critical Oct PCE print on November 25.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: September 2026 G4 M2 at $104.3T per MacroMicro (StreetStats: $103,884B as of Nov 18); October G4 data not yet published; 4-week Aug→Sep change +$0.64T (+0.6%), trend UP; status supportive (4-week trend up, no YoY contraction); held unchanged pending October G4 publication mid-to-late November.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: October 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 55.5% (released November 2), above consensus 54.7%, up from September's 54.5%; 4-week trend UP (Sep 54.5 → Oct 55.5, +1.0pp); status supportive (above 50 and rising); next release December 1, 2026 (November data).

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY touched 104.00 intraday November 19, 2026, a fresh 19-month high per FXStreet (Nov 18 close: 103.862 per ChainCatcher; Trading Economics: 103.89 on Nov 19); 4-week trend UP — from ~101.7 on October 20 to 104.00, net +~2.3%, well above the 0.5% flat threshold; hawkish Fed tone and hot October CPI driving the move; status headwind (above 100 threshold — must fall below 97.5 for supportive).

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: DFII10 at 2.92% as of November 16, 2026 per FRED (Nov 13: 2.91%, Nov 10: 2.78%); 4-week change Oct 14 (~2.85–2.90%) to Nov 16 (2.92%) = +2–7bps, within or at the 5bps flat threshold; status neutral (above 2% but flat trend — headwind requires both rising trend AND above 2%).

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: 2s10s spread at approximately +28–30bps as of November 17–18, 2026 per MacroMicro (28bps), SOFR Rate (29bps), and Stockmarketwatch (30bps); 4-week change essentially flat vs ~+28–32bps on October 14; status neutral (positive spread, curve not inverted — headwind requires < -50bps).

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL at $6,758,867M ($6.759T) as of November 11, 2026 per FRED H.4.1 (released November 12); 4-week change Oct 14 ($6.756T) → Nov 11 ($6.759T) = +$3B, flat; H.4.1 for week ended November 18 (today's scheduled release) not yet reflected; status supportive (flat balance sheet, QT ended, mild YoY growth +$178B).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: Coinglass OI-weighted BTC funding rate at 0.0040–0.0043% per 8h as of November 18–19, 2026 (futures page: 0.0040%; BTC page: 0.0043%; Glassnode: 0.002%; AltcoinBuzz/CoinGecko: 0.0016%); 30-day trend FLAT — near zero throughout October–November with brief negative dip November 16; status supportive (well below 0.04% headwind threshold, classic deleveraged accumulation signal).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$284B (DefiLlama as of Nov 18); BTC dominance ~59.3% (tv-hub.org Nov 2026) implies total crypto ~$2.16T; derived stablecoin dominance ~13.2%; 30-day trend UP — from ~10.7% on October 19 to ~13.2%; status neutral (rising stablecoin dominance but TOTAL market cap contracting from ~$2.6T on Oct 14 to ~$2.16T — headwind requires rising stables AND rising TOTAL simultaneously).

upcoming.title: S&P Global Flash PMIs (November 2026)
upcoming.note: S&P Global releases flash estimates for US Manufacturing and Services PMIs for November 2026 at 9:45 AM ET; first real-time read on November business activity ahead of the December 1 ISM PMI; a Services print above 55 would reinforce the sticky-inflation narrative heading into the December 9 FOMC decision; Euro area flash PMIs also released same morning.

upcoming.title: Conference Board Consumer Confidence (November 2026)
upcoming.note: Conference Board releases November 2026 Consumer Confidence Index at 10:00 AM ET (last Tuesday of month); tracks current conditions and 6-month expectations; a deterioration from October's level would signal cracks in the consumer spending backdrop ahead of the November 25 PCE release.

upcoming.title: GDP Q3 2026 — Second Estimate
upcoming.note: BEA releases Q3 2026 GDP second estimate at 8:30 AM ET (Thanksgiving-week compressed schedule, day before Thursday November 26 Thanksgiving); watch consumer spending and PCE deflator revisions for any upside that would reinforce the December 9 hike case; released same day as October PCE on thin pre-holiday liquidity.

upcoming.title: PCE Inflation / Personal Income (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BEA releases October 2026 Personal Income and Outlays at 8:30 AM ET; PCE is the Fed's preferred inflation gauge — a hot core reading above +0.3% MoM would seal the December 9 FOMC hike after October CPI surprised at +0.4% MoM; this is the last major inflation print before the ~November 29 FOMC blackout period.
